summary: Iteration 90 - MAARS Infinity New Features (Full Execution Loop, Metrics/Alerting, KG Advanced, Rate Limiting) fully tested. All 16 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend pages (Observability Dashboard, Commander Orion, Model Router) verified with all features working correctly. Real LLM integration via emergentintegrations library confirmed.

metrics_live.details: GET /api/infinity/metrics/live returns real-time metrics (total_agents, busy_agents, agent_utilization, circuit_breakers_tripped, open_incidents, model_success_rate_min) plus triggered_alerts array

metrics_history.details: GET /api/infinity/metrics/history returns historical snapshots for trend charts

alert_rules.details: GET /api/infinity/alerts/rules returns 6 default rules: circuit_breaker_tripped, high_budget_usage, low_success_rate, open_incidents, low_trust_agents, execution_failures

acknowledge_alert.details: POST /api/infinity/alerts/{rule_id}/acknowledge successfully marks alerts as acknowledged

kg_traverse.details: GET /api/infinity/memory/knowledge-graph/traverse/{entity} traverses graph with nodes, edges, depth_reached

kg_traverse_with_filter.details: GET /api/infinity/memory/knowledge-graph/traverse/{entity}?relationship=enables filters edges by relationship type

kg_search.details: GET /api/infinity/memory/knowledge-graph/search?q=AI performs fuzzy text search across entities

execution_runs.details: GET /api/infinity/orchestrator/runs returns execution history with run_id, graph_id, status, summary (nodes, cost, latency)

router_execute.details: POST /api/infinity/router/execute routes and executes task via real LLM, returns output with provider/model/latency/cost

rate_limiting.details: Rate limiter (120 req/60s per IP) does not trigger under normal use - 10 rapid requests all succeeded

full_execute_pipeline.details: POST /api/infinity/orchestrator/full-execute completes full pipeline (classify → decompose → execute → verify → report) in ~46s with real LLM calls

execute_graph.details: POST /api/infinity/orchestrator/execute-graph/{graph_id} endpoint works for executing existing graphs

commander_log_ai.details: GET /api/infinity/orchestrator/log shows AI classification metadata (ai_powered, model_used, decomposition_meta)

frontend_observability_dashboard.details: Dashboard shows: 7 live metrics cards (Agents 459, Utilization 100%, Networks 28, Breakers 0/13, Incidents 1, Models 6, Runs 3), Metrics Trend sparklines (Agent Utilization %, Min Model Success %, Open Incidents), Recent Execution Runs with completed status/cost, Circuit Breakers panel, Model Performance panel (gpt-5.2, gpt-4o-mini, gemini-3-pro-preview all 100%), Trust Leaderboard, auto-refresh controls (5s/10s/30s/60s)

frontend_commander_orion.details: Commander page shows: goal input textarea, mode selector (Full Execute/Plan Only), Execute Goal button, Recent Execution Runs with completed runs showing nodes/cost

frontend_model_router.details: Model Router page shows: task input, Route button (classification only), Execute button (with LLM call). Subtitle mentions 13 providers.

critical_code_review_comments: Full execution loop uses REAL LLM calls via emergentintegrations - NO MOCKS
Full execute takes 30-90 seconds due to multiple LLM calls (classify + decompose + N node executions + report)
Metrics collection aggregates data from multiple subsystems (circuit breakers, trust, incidents, workload, model performance)
Alert rules use threshold-based evaluation with operators (>, <, >=, ==)
Knowledge Graph traversal correctly handles max_depth and relationship filters
Rate limiting middleware set to 120 requests per 60 seconds per IP for /api/infinity/* endpoints
Frontend Observability Dashboard has proper auto-refresh with configurable rates (5s-60s)
All data-testid attributes present on key UI elements for testing
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed entities in Knowledge Graph for traversal/search/path tests. Full execute creates execution runs in execution_runs collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 90 tested all NEW features: Full Execution Loop (POST /api/infinity/orchestrator/full-execute takes 30-90s with real LLM), Metrics & Alerting (live metrics, history, 6 alert rules, acknowledge), Advanced KG (traverse, search, path finding), Rate Limiting (120 req/60s). Frontend pages (Observability Dashboard with live metrics/sparklines/execution runs, Commander Orion with full execute, Model Router with route+execute). All APIs use REAL LLM calls via emergentintegrations. Previous iterations 87-89 tested Phase 2-5 endpoints which all still work.
